svg.title: Raj Patel, AI engineer
svg.desc: Raj Patel (R204570). AI engineer building agents, vision models and the software around them, from idea to deployed. Now shipping DocsForge, an open-source MCP server in production (pipx install docsforge). Based in Ahmedabad, India; open to AI Engineering, Agentic AI and Data Science roles, and to freelance work. Credentials: Microsoft Elevate × GTU (2026), B.E. Information Technology with Data Science honours (2026), Intel AI for Manufacturing (2025), CPTE. 292 contributions in the last 26 weeks.
